_about: Generation Zero's 72 Steam achievements, read from the Steam client's own copy of the game's achievement schema (Steam\appcache\stats\UserGameStatsSchema_704270.bin, schema version 16): API name, name and description in every language Steam has, whether it is secret (hidden until unlocked), and its icon and locked (gray) icon. The icons are the files the schema names, from Steam's image server. The game files themselves hold only the achievement logic (missions/achievements.group.hpmissionsc), not the list or the icons.
